open_points.subject: _transport_log_record
open_points.text: _transport_log_record: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST build one line of exactly four labelled fields in this order and shape, so an operator log parser does not change between builds: 'rid=<request id> method=<method> path=<canonical path without query string> status=<status>'.
open_points.other_text: The line is bounded in its fields, not in its length: the path field is the canonical_path argument, which the caller already took from _canonical_path over the request path without its query string, written whole; it MUST NOT be truncated or shortened.
open_points.question: If canonical_path contains a newline, must it be escaped or altered to keep the record to one line, or must it be written whole?

open_points.question: If the canonical path itself contains credential or identity material, must the path be redacted, or must it be written whole without truncation or shortening?
